findings.issue: Length check uses >=, so a trimmed query of exactly 100 characters is rejected; spec allows exactly 100.
findings.evidence: book.ts:29 `if (trimmed.length >= SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH)`. A 100-char query throws SearchValidationError and returns 400.

findings.issue: Author clause interpolates the raw query into the SQL string (SQL injection) and skips %/_ escaping.
findings.evidence: book.ts:34 `OR author LIKE '%${trimmed}%'` while only [pattern] is bound. `o'brien` breaks the statement; `%` matches every author.
findings.refuter_reason: Template-string SQL with unescaped user text violates AC5.

findings.issue: /books/search is registered after /books/:id, so the alias is shadowed and never reaches searchHandler.
findings.refuter_reason: Spec requires search first; :id shadows it.

findings.issue: HTMX endpoint returns an empty list for missing or empty q instead of all books; whitespace-only q returns all books.
findings.refuter_reason: AC2 requires all books for an empty query.

findings.issue: Author is output unescaped with <%-, giving stored XSS; spec requires <%= %>.
findings.refuter_reason: Unescaped output violates spec and project rules.
